topics.title: Belief systems and the power of the bhakti tradition
topics.ncert_sections: Belief Systems; The power of the bhakti tradition; Regional saints and their messages

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the bhakti marga as a path to moksha and why it united people during political instability.
Identify bhakti saints of different regions and the messages of equality and oneness they spread.
Recognise the common patterns of continuity, patronage and participation seen in the 13th to 17th centuries.

topics.title: Sufism and its meeting with bhakti

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Sufism as a devotional path of Islam and the role of music such as qawwali in it.
Explain how Bhakti and Sufi traditions overlapped, including the work of Dara Shikoh.
Describe regional storytelling traditions such as puppetry and pattachitra.
Distinguish the Hindustani and Carnatic streams and the growth of dhrupad.
Explain how instruments like the sitar and tabla evolved while drawing on older Indian traditions.

topics.title: Miniature paintings and gardens
topics.ncert_sections: From Walls to Paper - Miniature Paintings; Changing Landscapes - Gardens

concepts.learning_objective: Compare Rajput and Mughal miniature painting and the exchanges between them.
Describe the charbagh design of Mughal gardens and how later gardens borrowed from it.

topics.title: Women in society: contextual variations in role and status
topics.ncert_sections: Women in Society - Contextual Variations in Their Role and Status

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why practices like purdah spread in some regions and not in others.
Identify the roles of women such as Razia Sultan and Nur Jahan in governance.
Interpret evidence of women's roles in public life in south India, especially Vijayanagara.

topics.title: Education, knowledge traditions and vocational learning
topics.ncert_sections: Education and Knowledge Traditions; Institutions of learning; Vocational education and knowledge sharing

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the institutions of learning of the period, from gurukulas and mathas to madrasas.
Explain why decentralised systems of learning survived political turmoil.
Describe how textile skills were passed on and enriched, as in Banarasi saris and pashmina shawls.

topics.title: Growth of literature and language
topics.ncert_sections: Growth of Literature and Language; The development of Urdu

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the growth of literature in regional languages under bhakti saints and royal patrons.
Identify translations between Sanskrit and Persian and their role in preserving knowledge.
Explain how Urdu and Dakhini developed by blending Indian and Persian-Arabic elements.

topics.title: Science, architecture and cultural exchange in daily life
topics.ncert_sections: Developments in Science and Technology; Regional Architectural Developments; Cultural Exchange in Daily Life

concepts.learning_objective: Identify advances in mathematics, astronomy and applied chemistry made in this period.
Explain how temple building and reconstruction showed cultural resilience.
Distinguish adoption from adaptation of foreign influences in food and clothing.
